summary: Two-project integration brief: Agent Loop proposes autonomous work (README.md:53); Tool Gate deterministically evaluates caller-supplied tool metadata and invocation envelopes before execution, returning allow, deny, or review_required receipts without executing tools (README.md:5-13,17-20). Their shared safety boundary separates agent intent from runtime side effects: planning remains non-authoritative until explicit policy evaluation permits execution. Actionable integration: require every Agent Loop tool proposal to pass through Tool Gate, execute only allow receipts, route review_required receipts to an operator, reject deny receipts, and persist the trace-linked receipt with the execution audit record. Agent Loop risk: a direct or alternate execution path could bypass the gate and turn an unchecked proposal into a side effect. Tool Gate risk: it trusts caller-supplied metadata and is neither an authorization system nor a sandbox, so inaccurate metadata or failure to enforce its receipt at the runtime can permit unsafe behavior (README.md:6-13,156-158). Declared clean-tree check passed; no files were modified.
